title: refactor(Development/AbelianVarietyTheory/Proofs/InertiaEigenvalues): deduplicate bounded disc period constructions
body:
Factors out the shared Frobenius inverse, disc-coefficient recurrence, and bounded period construction between `Seed` (`ExistsBoundedPeriodsDiscAinf.lean`) and `WSeed` (`ExistsBoundedSemistablePeriodsNullFamily.lean`), eliminating duplicated proofs across three modules with no new imports.

Declarations changed:
- Replaced `GlobalTheory.BSP.seed_frob_inverse` in `CrystallineLatticeFrobeniusInverseMatrix.lean` with the generalized `GlobalTheory.BSP.disc_frob_inverse` parameterized by period matrices `W`, `W'`, `M` and exponents `c`, `N`.
- Replaced `GlobalTheory.BSP.seed_coeff_recurrence` in `ExistsBoundedPeriodsDiscAinf.lean` with the generalized `GlobalTheory.BSP.coeff_recurrence_of_frob`.
- Added `GlobalTheory.BSP.exists_bounded_periods_of_frob` in `ExistsBoundedPeriodsDiscAinf.lean` and delegated `GlobalTheory.BSP.exists_bounded_periods` to it.
- Removed the duplicated `GlobalTheory.BKLim.wseed_frob_inverse` and `GlobalTheory.BSP.wseed_coeff_recurrence` from `ExistsBoundedSemistablePeriodsNullFamily.lean`, and delegated `GlobalTheory.BKLim.exists_bounded_periods_wseed` to `GlobalTheory.BSP.exists_bounded_periods_of_frob`.
